ShortDescription.Value: Automatically plans and builds your entire city's bus network: smart stop placement, optimized loop routes, depot connectivity, and an interactive plan preview before anything is built.

Publish.LongDescription:
Auto Bus Lines automatically designs and constructs complete, functional bus transit networks across your entire city — all without manual stop placement or route drawing.
Open the planner window, calculate a transit plan, review it interactively, tweak what you want, and hit **Build Selected**. That's it.
---
### How to Use
1. Build at least one **Bus Depot** or **Passenger Bus Terminal** in your city. 2. Open the **Auto Bus Lines** floating window from the top-right toolbar bus icon (or via Options > Mod Settings). 3. Go to the **Plan** tab and click **Calculate Transit Plan** to generate a full city-wide bus network proposal. 4. Review the proposed routes and stops in the interactive plan list. Toggle off any stops or entire lines you don't want. 5. Click **Build Selected** to construct only the approved routes — or **Discard** to start fresh with a **New Plan** variant. 6. If you upgrade roads or bulldoze something later, use **Repair Broken Bus Lines** in the **Settings** tab.
---
### Features
**Interactive Plan Mode** - Preview the full proposed bus network in a floating in-game window before anything is placed. - **Line & Stop Toggles**: Enable or disable individual stops or entire proposed lines before building. - **Alternative Plans**: Click **[New Plan]** to calculate a completely different corridor layout. - **Build Selected / Discard**: Build only what you approve. Discard safely without touching your city. - **Camera Focus**: Click the focus button on any stop to fly the camera directly to it. - **Variant Badge**: Shows which plan variant you're viewing (e.g. Variant #2).
**Smart Stop Placement** - Automatically places roadside bus stops along road spans, safely away from intersections. - Respects right-hand and left-hand traffic, divided roads, and one-way streets. - Reuses existing bus stops and station platforms wherever they already exist.
**Route Optimization** - Multi-corridor planner with 2-Opt path smoothing generates smooth, circular loop lines. - Connects all routes directly to your nearest Bus Depots and Bus Terminals.
**Vibrant Line Colors** - Per Station mode: each terminal hub gets a distinct vibrant color family (Metro Blue, Emerald, Orange, Violet, Crimson, Cyan, Amber...). Lines sharing a hub get cohesive shades — never dull or washed-out. - Random mode: 16 hand-picked vivid transit colors, each line instantly recognizable.
**Custom Bus Stop Support** - Built-in support for vanilla EU and NA stop models (shelter, sign, bikes). - Works with modded/custom bus stop prefabs: pick your custom stop model in Settings and it appears in the selector with its mod thumbnail if available.
**Settings Tab** - Stop density presets: Balanced, Dense, Ultra / Every Block, Low / Express, Custom. - Target stop spacing slider (60m – 500m). - Min/max stops per line, maximum route length. - Line color scheme (Per Station or Random Rainbow). - Custom bus stop model selector with visual thumbnails. - Auto-generate on city load toggle. - Repair Broken Bus Lines tool.
---

Publish.ChangeLog:
### v1.1.9
**Vibrant Transit Colors** - Completely replaced the old golden-ratio HSV color generation with a curated 16-color vibrant transit palette (Electric Blue, Safety Orange, Vivid Emerald, Neon Violet, Crimson, Cyan, Amber, Deep Pink and more). - Per Station mode: each bus station/terminal hub now anchors to a bold, distinct color family. Lines within the same hub get cohesive shades while staying punchy — saturation locked at 0.88–0.96, brightness at 0.96–1.0 so colors never look dull or muddy. - Random mode: now uses the same hand-picked palette for the first 16 lines; overflow lines use high-saturation HSV. - Street lines with no station hub now get their own dedicated palette entries instead of sharing hub color space.
**Plan Tab Cleanup** - Removed the color mode toggle button from the Plan tab action toolbar (color scheme is already fully configurable in the Settings tab — no need to have it in two places). - Removed the "Generate Bus Lines Now" button from Settings maintenance section (use "Calculate Transit Plan" in the Plan tab instead). - Removed the "Preview Plan Before Building" checkbox (the Plan tab already handles this workflow).
**Custom Bus Stop Mod Support** - The bus stop model selector in Settings now supports modded/custom bus stop prefabs. - If a custom mod defines a bus stop, it appears in the selector with its mod thumbnail (squared card layout) alongside vanilla stops. - Cards use fixed-dimension layout (no Cohtml layout loops or flickering).
**UI Improvements** - Fixed bus stop model selector card layout: all cards are uniform squares in a stable 4-column grid — no more giant single-box or flickering. - Plan tab now shows a configuration hint banner pointing users to Settings, with a direct "Open Settings" button. - Settings tab has a direct "Open Settings" shortcut from the Plan toolbar.
